receivePath.tokenBaseFormula: record i uses token positions 1 + i*9 through 9 + i*9

offset0x114.downstreamUse: used by BattleButtonPPLSKILL to construct a battle-skill UI image identifier by adding 0xf4fa

initialization.beforeParse: all 26 records set useFlag=0 and kind=0
initialization.skillIndexArrays: AdvanceSkill, AssitSkill, BattleSkill reset to -1 before classification

sortSkill.behavior: Each valid record index is appended in ascending original record-index order to the array matching its kind; unrecognized kind values are skipped.
sortSkill.ordering: stable with respect to the original 0..25 profession-skill record index scan

battleSkillUiIntegration.grid: up to 4 columns x 4 rows are iterated for each mode; -1 terminates a row's useful entries

eligibility.normalResourceGate: native resource value must be >= profession_skill.costmp and costmp must be nonzero
eligibility.knownHpRestriction: skillId 40 is blocked when player hp <= 10
eligibility.specialZeroCostException: skillId 11 can pass the zero-cost path in the assist mode

battleSkillUiIntegration.selectionResult: selected skill index stored in prouseskill or the corresponding battle selection state, followed by BattleSetWazaHitBox(profession_skill[target], 1)

returnRules.numericResult: Lua numeric result converted with cvttsd2si to signed int after lua_tonumber; stack is cleared

luaClassificationBridge.errorHandling: Lua errors are logged through SDL_Log before stack cleanup

directUse: rebuild three profession-skill categories using kind
preserve native record order in each category
feed browser battle-skill UI from the same 26-record -> 3-array pipeline
treat getProfessionSkillType as a separate Lua-backed presentation-classification value rather than conflating it with kind
boundaries: The body of Lua getProfessionSkillType is not present in the APK and is supplied externally at runtime.
The semantic meaning of the returned integer is observed from its UI image-number use, not independently named beyond that.
Server-side skill balance and effect execution remain outside this client-side receive/sort contract.
